title: GTA 6 Has 480 Trading Cards: How to Cash Them
short_title_options: GTA 6 cards: sell them for up to $1,000+ 🃏 #GTA6 #Shorts
short_description:
GTA 6 has 480 collectible cards in 18 sets, and each comes in bronze, silver and gold. Sell them at any pawn shop: guides list anything from about $20 to over $1,000 depending on rarity. No story spoilers.

Sources: games.gg, MetaForge, NSS Sports, GTA Wiki.
